# S56 — Pantry questions and numbered replies

larder asks about uncertain or low items, and numbered replies correct the estimates (ADR 0027).

**Findings:** C5 · **Size:** M · **Tree:** core

**Not in this slice:** free-form answers (LLM fallback is Later).

## Why

A one-digit reply is the cheapest way to keep pantry estimates honest.

## Owner input

The weekly question cap and the days come from ADR 0028 (S61). Nothing else to ask.
